CustomField.description: Number of days from Created Date to Close Date for closed Opps, Created Date to Today for open Opps
CustomField.formula: IF( IsClosed, CloseDate - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of days from Created Date to Close Date for closed Opps, Created Date to Today for open Opps
CustomField.label: Sales Cycle Duration (Days)
